# Changelog

## 0.1.0 — 2026-10-06

- Add Gregorian leap-year, month-length, weekday, ordinal-day, and ISO-week helpers.
- Add data-first month grids with configurable week starts, five/six-row behavior, outside dates, blank mode, localized labels, and event records.
- Add themed month rendering, twelve-month overviews, and A4/US Letter page helpers.
- Add compiling examples and arithmetic/grid assertions.
